Most speed dating is built around small talk.

Tantra Speed Date® is different.

Instead of trying to impress one another, you'll be guided through a series of playful connection exercises designed to help you relax, be yourself, and discover genuine chemistry.

You'll meet up to 20 singles in one evening while exploring conversation, eye contact, movement, and connection in a way that feels natural.

Along the way, you'll probably laugh, surprise yourself, and discover that dating doesn't have to be awkward or exhausting.

Since 2017, more than 359,341 guided first dates have taken place through Tantra Speed Date® in over 50 cities worldwide. 94.09% of participants leave with at least one mutual match. If you don't, your next event is on us.

Here's what participants are saying:

* "BEST singles event I've ever been to." - Stacia, Dating Coach (Seattle)

* "I met the love of my life." - Catherine B. (Denver)

* "Unquestionably the best dating event I have ever attended. It's transformative!" - John N.

* "I now have a much deeper understanding of what it means to be a man in a relationship." - Justin M.
